tool_input.command:
cat > "$TMPDIR/exercise.py" <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
import detect.cli as cli
from state.unpark import is_owner_actor

class GH:
    actor = None
    def label_actor(self, repo, number, label):
        return {"ok": True, "actor": self.actor, "reason": ""}
gh = GH()
cli._github = lambda: gh
import os
os.environ.pop("GITHUB_REPOSITORY", None)
os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER"] = "the-owner"
cases = [
    ("colleague", {}), ("the-owner", {}), ("THE-OWNER", {}),
    ("github-actions[bot]", {}), ("the-owner", {"owner": "colleague"}),
    ("colleague", {"owner": "colleague"}),
    ("sdlc-bot", {"automation_identity": ["sdlc-bot"], "owner": "sdlc-bot"}),
]
for actor, cfg in cases:
    gh.actor = actor
    print(repr(actor), cfg, "->", cli._human_label_actor("o/r", 12, "sdlc:go", cfg))
del os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER"]
gh.actor = "o"
print("no env, repo o/r, actor o ->", cli._human_label_actor("o/r", 12, "sdlc:go", {}))
gh.actor = "the-owner"
print("no env, repo o/r, actor the-owner ->", cli._human_label_actor("o/r", 12, "sdlc:go", {}))
print("unknown owner ->", is_owner_actor("someone", {}, {}, None))
EOF
